properties.title: Nihonbashi to the Miya ferry landing
Saya Kaido — the historical land route
properties.rationale: The Edo-period overland alternative to the Seven-ri sea crossing, via Saya and the Kiso Three Rivers bridges. Walking it makes the route continuous without inventing a modern line.
